hits.title: General Fusion files to register 110M new shares - GFUZ - Stock Titan
hits.snippet: 4. [F-1] General Fusion Group Ltd. Foreign Issuer IPO Registration. F-1 registers a large resale overhang in GFUZ plus significant potential warrant-based share issuance that could raise cash only if exercised for cash. (GFUZ)** filed a shelf-style registration covering up to **109,928,827 Subordinate Voting Shares** issuable upon exercise or conversion of warrants, Multiple Voting Shares and Earnout Shares, and the resale by existing holders of **102,402,511 Subordinate Voting Shares**, related warrants and converted shares. The company will **not** receive proceeds from resales by selling securityholders but would receive up to **$339.9 million** in gross proceeds if all fee-bearing Spring Valley, SAFE and PIPE warrants are exercised for cash. Subordinate Voting Shares were **53,132,058** outstanding as of September 4, 2026.
